premises.text: Enterprise design-to-manufacture handoffs across heterogeneous machines, software, and decentralized sites are cumbersome (Excel/file shares)
premises.evidence_span: On one side, they have all these machines, and all these machines have different software and operators. And on the other side, you have designers. And all day, they go back and forth with Excel files, spreadsheets, file shares

premises.text: A cloud manufacturing platform connects 3D printers, CNC, water jets, robots, and assembly workflows for one-click remote job control
premises.evidence_span: it's not just 3D printers, it's connecting all these machines and workflows in the cloud, anytime, anywhere

premises.text: Fog clients take over shop-floor machines that normally rely on SD cards and USB sticks
premises.evidence_span: we've got a client that runs in what we call the fog, which connects to the cloud and takes control of the machine

premises.text: Factories and workflows can be duplicated and relocated across sites from the same cloud control plane
premises.evidence_span: if I want to duplicate the factory, this is my San Francisco factory, I click Duplicate, and now I've got another factory

premises.text: Monetization is a per-site enterprise license

value.text: Take an idea to a real manufactured object instantly, anytime, anywhere
value.evidence_span: taking an idea to a real object instantly, anytime, anywhere
